name: Multi open projects
description:
1. The task was to add a Slack/Discord-style quick project switcher to `DesktopSidebar`, letting users jump between "pinned" projects.
2. A pin/unpin toggle button was added in `AppsSection.vue`, positioned after `ProjectDetailt` and before the `ViewModeToggle` (desktop) button.
3. Pinned project IDs are stored in `localStorage` via the existing UI store (`src/store/ui.js`), leveraging the built-in `saveState()`/`loadState()` persistence.
4. A new `PinnedProjectsSwitcher.vue` component was created to render the list of pinned projects (avatar + name), adapting to both collapsed rail and expanded sidebar states.
5. Clicking a pinned project calls the existing `activeProjectChanged(project)` flow, reusing the loading overlay, chat reload, and route sync, with full accessibility (focus rings, `aria-pressed`, tooltips).
